meaning: Liking to talk a lot.
example: My cousin is so talkative that she never stops.
exampleTamil: என் உறவுக்காரப் பொண்ணு ரொம்ப பேசுவா, நிறுத்தவே மாட்டா.

meaning: Caring only about yourself and not about others.
example: Don't be selfish, share the sweets with everyone.

meaning: Always supporting your friends, family or company.
example: He is a loyal friend who never leaves you alone.
exampleTamil: அவன் உன்னைத் தனியா விடாத விசுவாசமான நண்பன்.

meaning: Having good sense; making wise choices.
example: It is sensible to save some money every month.
exampleTamil: ஒவ்வொரு மாசமும் கொஞ்சம் பணம் சேமிக்கிறது புத்திசாலித்தனம்.

meaning: Acting in a silly way, like a small child.
example: Stop being childish and say sorry to her.

meaning: Feeling that everything is turning around you.
example: I felt dizzy after standing in the sun for an hour.
exampleTamil: ஒரு மணி நேரம் வெயில்ல நின்னதால எனக்கு தலை சுத்துச்சு.

meaning: Painful when touched or used.
example: My legs are sore after the long walk.
exampleTamil: நீண்ட நடைக்குப் பிறகு என் கால் வலிக்குது.

meaning: Making you want to scratch your skin.
example: This sweater feels itchy on my neck.

meaning: Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.
example: The clothes are still damp because of the rain.

meaning: Warm and wet in a way that feels uncomfortable.
example: Chennai gets muggy just before the rain.

meaning: With strong wind, heavy rain and dark clouds.
example: The sea was stormy, so the fishermen stayed home.
exampleTamil: கடல் கொந்தளிப்பா இருந்ததால மீனவர்கள் வீட்டிலேயே இருந்தாங்க.

meaning: Nice and enjoyable.
example: The evening was cool and pleasant.

meaning: Making you feel a little angry or irritated.
example: The mosquitoes at night are so annoying.

meaning: Not interesting; makes you feel tired of it.
example: The meeting was long and boring.

meaning: Strong and well made; not easy to break.
example: This table is sturdy enough to hold a TV.
exampleTamil: இந்த மேசை டிவியைத் தாங்கும் அளவுக்கு உறுதியா இருக்கு.

meaning: Having too much salt or tasting of salt.
example: The curry is a bit salty today.

meaning: Full of oil or fat.
example: I don't like greasy food late at night.
exampleTamil: இரவு நேரத்துல எண்ணெய் அதிகமான சாப்பாடு எனக்குப் பிடிக்காது.

meaning: Smooth or wet so that you can easily slide and fall.
example: The floor is slippery, so walk slowly.

meaning: Able to stick to things; covered with something like glue.
example: My hands are sticky from the jackfruit.

meaning: Bright and reflecting light.
example: She wore a shiny silk saree to the wedding.

meaning: Not able to hurt anyone or cause damage.
example: Don't be afraid, this little snake is harmless.
exampleTamil: பயப்படாதே, இந்தச் சின்னப் பாம்பு தீங்கு செய்யாது.

meaning: Too small, with not enough space to move.
example: The train compartment was cramped and hot.

meaning: Very small.
example: There was a tiny ant on my notebook.
exampleTamil: என் நோட்டுப்புத்தகத்துல ஒரு சின்ன எறும்பு இருந்தது.

meaning: Very big.
example: They have a huge garden behind the house.
exampleTamil: அவங்க வீட்டுக்குப் பின்னாடி ஒரு பெரிய தோட்டம் இருக்கு.

meaning: Not useful; having no good use.
example: This old charger is useless now.
exampleTamil: இந்தப் பழைய சார்ஜர் இப்போ எதுக்கும் உதவாது.
